title: The watch Ryan Gosling wears for TAG Heuer
why: Evergreen celebrity post, not news: never say 'new'. Gosling became a TAG Heuer ambassador in October 2021 with the Carrera Three Hands campaign (confirm on TAG Heuer's own magazine page and LVMH). Cover: the TAG Heuer campaign photo of him wearing the Carrera (photo.js press, already in the library as press-tag-heuer-ryan-gosling.jpg). Use only facts on those two pages.

hard_gate_failures: Gate 2/3/4: Slide 5's premiere and Seafarer claim (9 March 2026, London, Project Hail Mary) has no verified claim in research.json. CLM-5 only covers the campaign image. Esquire Australia and AOL are not listed as sources. The caption and the footers of slides 2-5 cite them anyway.
Gate 7: Slide 5 shows a December 2023 BFI portrait under a headline about a March 2026 premiere, and it shows no Seafarer watch.
fixes: slide 5: Delete it, or rebuild it only after the premiere claim is added to research.json as a verified claim, from a primary source or two trusted outlets and kept as 'reportedly'. Then use a photo that shows that watch.
slides 2-5 footers and caption: Cite only 'TAG Heuer Magazine, Oct 2021'. Remove Esquire Australia and AOL unless they are verified in research.json.

slide 4: Replace it or merge it into the cover. It repeats the cover photo and adds nothing new. If you replace it, show a close-up of the watch on his wrist, since the watch is visible in the photo, and keep 'no watch identified'.
caption: Remove the premiere paragraph and 'Current angle'. Keep it to the verified October 2021 facts.
verdict.reason: The post is built on a single official TAG Heuer article, and its facts check out. But slide 5 states a 2026 premiere watch that no claim in research.json supports, and it sits over an unrelated 2023 photo. Fix that and the repeated slide 4, then resubmit.
